summary: Wix.com Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, containing a press release of its second quarter 2026 financial results. The release reports Q2 revenue of $563.1 million, up 15% year-over-year, and bookings of $569.1 million, up 12%, with commentary on AI product launches and margin improvements. This is a routine quarterly earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No transaction, strategic review, or governance change is involved. The filing is purely informational and does not trigger any corporate action warranting classification.
